style: Soft modern flat vector illustration in aubergine (#2a1f33), mint (#7ee0c3) and white, rounded gentle shapes, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A calm suburban workshop interior: a car on a lift, a mint tool chest, a pegboard with tools, a window with trees and a quiet road outside. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems. Flat vector, DARK aubergine overall, mint highlights, white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
